scenes.summary: You meet Carly in the Worker Dorms and learn that she wants to make a storybook that will bring joy to everyone.

lines.text: I'm here, Endmin!
Yeah, because I've met you before! You visited this place, remember?
The Endmin is really here!
'Cos I wanna draw a storybook that makes everyone happy.
Everyone said you go on adventures EVERY SINGLE DAY! They also said you went to TONS of interesting places.
I wanna go to those places and draw your story so that everyone can see them too.
But the grown-ups said the places outside aren't safe and won't let me leave...
Endmin, can you take photos of your adventure? I'll then draw them out and complete my storybook.
You agreed?! I knew you're the best Endmin! The bestest of Talos-II!
Take this! I made a list of all the places I wanna draw.

options: Why do you want to see me, Carly?
Anything I can do to help?
What are the places you want to photograph?

r: Why do you want to see me, Carly?
Anything I can do to help?
What are the places you want to photograph?

lines.text: Thank you for helping me draw my storybook!
Concrete Jungle ... Princess Carly ... and Knights of the Sky!
The grown-ups told me about a castle in the sky with all sorts of knights who'd protect us! The Endmin lives in that castle too!
I wanna draw Princess Carly going on an adventure with the Knights of the Sky!

options: About the "Princess who Escaped to the Concrete Jungle".

lines.text: It's very tall, you know! Very, very, very tall!
I wanna head back to my old place and look at it. But whenever I said that, the grown-ups would start looking sad...
The grown-ups told me that Valley IV is our home now. They all promised to be Carly's family.
But I still wanna look at my old place. If I could climb that very, very, very tall tower, I'll be able to see it!

options: About the "Very Very Very Tall Tower".

lines.text: Grampa Gate Guard told me that the Endmin defeated an evil and naughty big bad at this very place!
I wanna draw it in so that people who read the storybook will remember that we have the Endmin helping us! That'll make us less scared of the naughty big bad!

options: About the "Castle Attacked by the Evil Caster".

lines.text: My friends and I used to play there, you know. But the grown-ups suddenly showed up and said: NO...
We used to build castles with bricks. And we'll have princesses and knights as well. That super big crane is the great giant who protects us!
Everybody wants to go there and play again.
I remember your last visit, Endmin! You came with a pretty miss who has horns on her head!
I went and asked the grown-ups who told me she's a Lung.
I bet ALL of your companions are super amazing, Endmin!
So I am also betting Miss Lung is an awesome hero who can protect everyone too!
So, the stony sapling actually exists, you know...
The grown-ups told me that the Big, Big Oak of Stone is the hope for the entire Valley IV...
If I could draw the sapling of the Big, Big Oak of Stone, that would definitely make people happy!

options: About the "Sapling of the Big, Big Oak of Stone".

lines.text: My friends told me about a place that seems to be Evil Caster's castle.
Everyone said that was where the Endmin saved all of our lives.
So I thought about drawing the Knights of the Sky and the Lung in my storybook! And how they defeated the glowing Evil Caster!
Endmin, I'm here!

options: Wait. I suddenly got something to do.

r: Wait. I suddenly got something to do.

lines.text: Thank you, Endmin! I'm finally done with my storybook!
Everyone will really like it!
I wanna show everyone my storybook now!
But the grown-ups are always so busy and tired... Nobody has time to play with me. I'm so bored.
But I have my storybook now! It'll make everyone happy!
Nah. I wanna do that on my own!
I wanna draw more storybooks about the Endmin and other people too!
But I'm out of crayons... I can only start drawing again when I get new crayons...
You'll be the first to know when I start my new storybook!

options: Want me to show it to them?
